title: A user-centric Asset Management platform for Edgeware
body:
##### **Grant Proposal**
**Defolio: Asset Management Platform **
**Author: **Chris Thomas
_29th March 2021_

### **Summary**

This grant seeks to fund a user-centric asset management platform on Edgeware, that will drive further adoption on both Edgeware and DeFi. Given our team's deep experience in early-stage products, user-centric design, and strong foundations in crypto and financial services we see a valid need for an ‘easy-to-use' portfolio-based Asset Management service that addresses a broader set of stakeholders, specifically the long tail of EDG holders created through the lockdrop distribution.

The grant will fund a rapid-build development team with support from a product designer, time with a user experience advisor, a project manager, and an operational team for marketing, communications and general admin.

### **Team:**

- **Chris Thomas - **Head of Digital Assets at a Swiss bank & former founder in crypto and serial entrepreneur. 
- _**Crypto Product Manager **_at a Swiss Bank - In crypto since 2014, Invested in over 10 DeFi presales
- _**Crypto developer **_at a Swiss bank. Architecture and web interface focused. 
- _**User-centric specialist **_- former Head of IDEO Germany, consulted on design thinking globally for startups to multinationals for twenty years. 


We would also use funds to hire further developers to compliment our strengths and ensure a high-quality, timely product. _** **_

### **Introduction**

Our team has held initial discussions with Thom Ivy to understand the benefits of using Edgeware as well as the networks’ need for public good infrastructure and specifically community-development infrastructure that reaches more of Edgeware’s stakeholder groups. This grant seeks to provide a solution within this scope: 

**90% of crypto users are missing out on significant investment opportunities. Why? Because creating a crypto investment portfolio is complex, technical and time-consuming to those who don’t dedicate their lives to crypto
